findings.current: Woo Jintae’s head snapped to the side with a satisfyingly solid sound. He stared blankly at the floor, one hand pressed to his cheek.
findings.defect: The draft replaces his action of blankly stroking his cheek with staring at the floor and merely pressing a hand to it.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly describes him rubbing or stroking his cheek and says nothing about looking at the floor.
findings.replacement: Woo Jintae’s head snapped to the side with a satisfyingly solid sound. He blankly stroked his cheek.
findings.source: 찰진 소리와 함께 우진태의 고개가 옆으로 돌아갔다. 그는 멍하니 자신의 뺨을 쓰다듬었다.

findings.current: He glared at the little bastard in front of him with murderous intent.
findings.defect: The established term 살기 is rendered as “murderous intent” rather than the binding “killing intent.”
findings.rationale: The glossary requires “killing intent,” and the source specifically places it in his gaze.
findings.replacement: He glared at the little bastard in front of him with eyes full of killing intent.
findings.source: 그는 살기 어린 눈빛으로 눈앞의 애새끼를 노려봤다.

findings.current: Even if he hadn’t been born with extraordinary talent, it was only natural that he took pride in being a move or two ahead of other young prodigies.
findings.defect: The definite expression 일초반식 is changed into the indefinite quantity “a move or two.”
findings.rationale: The source specifies 일초반식, literally a move and a half, rather than a range of one or two moves.
findings.replacement: Even if he hadn’t been born with extraordinary talent, it was only natural that he took pride in being a move and a half ahead of the other young prodigies.
findings.source: 그러니 뛰어난 무재를 타고나진 않았어도 여타 후기지수에 비해 일초반식은 앞선다고 자부하는 것도 당연했다.

findings.current: That was when the young martial artist who had been standing around blankly, watching the fire across the river, suddenly asked,
findings.defect: The idiom 강 건너 불구경 is translated as if he were literally watching a fire across a river.
findings.rationale: The phrase means watching someone else’s trouble from a safe distance, not observing an actual fire or river.
findings.replacement: That was when the young martial artist who had been standing idly by as though none of this concerned him suddenly asked,
findings.source: 멀뚱멀뚱, 강 건너 불구경만 하고 있던 젊은 무인이 불쑥 물었다.

findings.current: What, do you want to hear where I’m from and who I am, then pick a fight if I seem easy and tuck your tail between your legs and apologize if my level is too high?
findings.defect: “My level is too high” recasts 급 as martial power, while Woo Jintae is trying to determine the opponent’s institutional status and backing.
findings.rationale: The surrounding reasoning centers on whether the opponent belongs to a powerful sect and therefore outranks someone Woo Jintae can safely offend.
findings.replacement: What, you want to hear who I am and where I’m from, then pick a fight if I seem easy and tuck your tail between your legs and apologize if I turn out to be too high-status?
findings.source: 왜, 어디의 누구인지 들어 본 다음 만만하면 한판 붙고 급이 좀 높다 싶으면 꼬리 말고 사과하게?

findings.current: Born as the sole son of three generations of the Seongun Escort Bureau’s main line, he had been pampered and revered his entire life.
findings.defect: The draft adds an unsupported “main line” and renders 삼대독자 in an awkward way that obscures his status as the family’s sole male heir across three generations.
findings.rationale: 삼대독자 identifies Woo Jintae as the only male heir born to the family in three generations; the source does not mention a main line.
findings.replacement: Born the sole male heir the Seongun Escort Bureau’s family had produced in three generations, he had been pampered and revered his entire life.
findings.source: 성운표국의 삼대독자로 태어나 평생을 떠받들어져 살아온 그다.

findings.current:
One slap with every step.

By the time Woo Jintae had taken five steps, he had been struck five times in total. He staggered unsteadily.
findings.defect: The draft states that Woo Jintae took exactly five steps, while the source only correlates slaps with steps and explicitly counts the five blows.
findings.rationale: The source leaves the subject and total number of the steps unstated but expressly says Woo Jintae was struck five times.
findings.replacement:
One slap with every step.

After taking five slaps in all, Woo Jintae staggered unsteadily.
findings.source: 한 걸음에 한 대씩. 도합 다섯 대를 맞은 우진태가 비틀거렸다.

findings.current: At the very least, we should try to stop them… Young Master Wang, do something.
findings.defect: The plural object “them” changes the target of intervention from the single attacker to both men.
findings.rationale: 말리기 refers to stopping Jin Taekyung from continuing the beating, not separating or stopping both participants.
findings.replacement: At the very least, we should try to stop him… Young Master Wang, do something.
findings.source: 최소한 말리기라도 해야…… 왕 공자가 어떻게 좀 해 봐요.

findings.current:
“I will!”

“We’ll do it! We’ll definitely do it!”
findings.defect: The second speaker’s singular commitment is changed to a plural commitment on behalf of the group.
findings.rationale: Both Korean lines use singular first-person verb endings from separate speakers; the second speaker does not volunteer everyone else.
findings.replacement:
“I will!”

“I’ll do it! I’ll definitely do it!”

findings.current:
“All right, then. There’s one final thing left—the second-to-last.”

“...Second-to-last?”
findings.defect: The draft changes “the second and final thing” into “the second-to-last,” incorrectly implying that another step will follow.
findings.rationale: 마지막 modifies the remaining item as the final one, while 두 번째 identifies it as the second requirement; it does not mean penultimate.
findings.replacement:
“All right, then. There’s one final thing left—the second.”

“…The second?”
findings.source:
“자, 그럼 마지막 두 번째가 남았습니다.”

“……두 번째라니?”

findings.current: “All of you, get your heads down.”
findings.defect: The English is ambiguous and softens the coarse command to bend over and plant their heads down as punishment.
findings.rationale: 대가리 박다 is a deliberately crude command to assume a head-down punishment posture, not merely to lower or duck one’s head.
findings.replacement: “All of you, bend over and plant your heads on the floor.”

summary: The draft contains several altered actions, subjects, and quantities, plus a mistranslated sequence marker and localized terminology and register issues.
